content.comment_body: When I attempt to save a .bin file, I receive the error message: "Failed to save as *.bin file. Details in the info window." I am running [product_name] [version_no]. Any advice?
Where is the SD card inserted—on your PC or in the [product_name] device?
On the PC, I am trying to transfer a program from the computer to the [product_name].

What information does the info window display? Is the SD card formatted using FAT32, and what is its capacity? I tested with [product_name] [version_no] versions and did not encounter issues. Also, if you can, please attach your [product_name] program as a ZIP file with your next post.

I do not receive an info window. The SD card is 2GB, formatted to 32-bit. I am wondering if there is something wrong with the program, but I installed it from the disc included in the starter kit [article_no].
The info window should indicate the issue: you have two blocks with outputs left open.
Connect open connectors to close the outputs on those two blocks.
Here is the bin file for your program. The file name is "[product_name]_U_P.bin", which is the only name accepted by [product_name] and [product_name] [product_name].
Thank you very much! It's much easier when someone explains it. I'm glad everything works now—good to have confirmation. Thanks again!
In the lower right corner, you can open the info window by clicking the symbol when it appears.

analysis.insight_summary: The user had problems saving a .bin file to an SD card with [product_name] [version_no]. The error message provided limited details, and the info window was not helpful. The real issue involved project configuration—specifically, outputs in two blocks left open. After another user explained this and guided the fix, the file could be saved successfully. This exchange highlights challenges with error feedback clarity and finding diagnostic information.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward process to save a .bin file to the SD card using the software, along with clearer guidance on any problems encountered during the save operation.
